counting_method: Page-aware pdftotext extraction with heading-bounded functional segments, followed by visual reconciliation against both 25-page contact sheets and full-resolution renders for image-layer pages. ASCII lexical words are counted after line-break repair; display equations, captions, tables, and repeated third-party watermarks are excluded from prose interpretation. PDF page 2 is a contents page and is excluded from the 24-page technical denominator.
ambiguities: PDF pages 1, 2, 5, 8, and 18 are image-layer pages; their mechanical text counts are incomplete and must be replaced by visual counts in the schema-v3 record.
Page fractions use unique touched pages and are non-additive because model-establishment and results are interleaved on the same physical pages.
The paper reports model definitions and numerical results in alternating subsections, so the functional results chapter intentionally overlaps the model-establishment page range.
The section headed Model II contains several distinct analytical branches: historical traffic decay, age inversion, renovation, material source, and temporal-use classification.
References and the map-only appendix are retained because they complete the source and visualization trail; their reusable language evidence is limited to source labeling and caption function.
